PAYMENT TERMS: The payment shall be released in 30 days from the date of GRN and acceptance of ma terial. Payment shall be made through NEFT /RTGS mode. Plus GST as Applicable. 2. The tenderer will be responsible for building awareness among their concerned employees about the ap plicable rules regarding environment. 5. Anti-bribery Undertaking: By participating in this tender, the suppliers / Vendors/Contractors are deeme d to have undertaken that they shall not give or take any financial or non-financial bribe, to or from anyon e during the tender or during the execution of the contract thereafter and if they notice any such incident h appening, they shall report it to SAIL Vigilance. Eligibility Criteria: Technical Eligibility Criteria – Supply of Ball & Roller Bearings 1.OEM or authorized vendor only. The bidder must be the OEM or an authorized vendor of the OEM. •An OEM must submit a self-declaration. •An authorized vendor must upload a bid-specific authorization certificate from the OEM, referencing this GeM bid number, along with the bid. 2.Past supply experience. The bidder must have executed at least 3 (three) purchase orders of value at lea st Rs.1Laksh each for supply of ball/roller bearings in the last 7 years, counted up to the bid opening date. These orders must be from Central/State Govt. departments, PSUs or Public Limited Companies. Copies of all the POs must be uploaded with the bid. 3.Performance / acceptance certificate. For each PO submitted under clause 2, the bidder must submit a s atisfactory performance certificate or an acceptance certificate from the respective customer. 4.Genuine and new material. Bearings must be new, genuine and of the quoted make. They must be suppli ed in original OEM packing with OEM marking and batch number. Refurbished bearings are not acceptable. An undertaking to this effect must be submitted with the bid. 5.Test certificate. The OEM test certificate or inspection report must be supplied along with each consignm ent. An undertaking to this effect must be submitted with the bid. 6.Guarantee. A minimum standard manufacturer guarantee of 12 months from commissioning, or 18 mont hs from supply, whichever is earlier, applies to all bearings. Any defective bearing must be replaced free o f cost. A guarantee undertaking is submitted with the bid, and the guarantee certificate is submitted with t he supply.

7.Compliance statement. A signed item-wise compliance to the technical specification and make must be s ubmitted. 8.Rejection. Any bid without the above documents will be rejected. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
